connector.name: Mintverdict
connector.registryDescription: Solana token risk verdicts, rug checks & outcome labels for AI agents. Pay-per-call x402 USDC.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mintverdict-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.mintverdict, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: 0x-prefixed private key of a DEDICATED low-value EVM wallet holding USDC on Base. Signs gasless per-call USDC payments (x402); never sent anywhere. Omit to get price quotes without paying.

env.name: MINTVERDICT_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL (default https://api.mintverdict.com).
